name: r1233zd_thermal_conductivity
title: Thermal conductivity of R1233zd(E) - Perkins & Huber correlation
summary: Two EES FUNCTIONs giving the thermal conductivity of R1233zd(E) from a temperature and a pressure as the sum of a dilute-gas term and a residual term: the coefficient set written in the original LaboThapPy function and the coefficient set of Table 1 of Perkins & Huber (2017), which differ by 8-17 %. The density comes from the built-in R1233zd(E) property functions. Demonstrated at the two state points published in Table 2 of the paper and at four heat-pump states of this fluid.

authors: R. A. Perkins (thermal conductivity correlation, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62:2659-2665, 2017)
M. L. Huber (thermal conductivity correlation, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62:2659-2665, 2017)

verification.reference: Re-run of the original LaboThapPy conducticity_R1233zd in a throw-away virtual environment (work/r1233zd_cond, pip install ~/git/LaboThapPy, CoolProp 8.0.0) at the six demonstration states, plus the two state points of Table 2 of Perkins & Huber, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62(9):2659-2665, 2017
verification.notes: compare_solution.py against the re-run of the original function: 8 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 4; only in CoolSolve: 18. The eight values are bit-identical at the printed precision (same arithmetic, same CoolProp density backend). The four variables only in the reference (rho_C, rho_D, rho_E, rho_F) are densities the reference script prints but the demonstration program does not store. Physics check against the paper: conductivity_R1233zd_published gives 0.091346 W/m-K at 300 K / 1308.8 kg/m3 (published 0.091399, -0.06 %); at 445 K / 168.52 kg/m3 it gives 0.023992 against the published 0.026141 (-8.22 %), the difference being the critical enhancement neither function implements. The coefficient set of the original does not reproduce the paper: +8.35 % at 300 K / 1308.8 kg/m3 and +16.66 % at 445 K / 168.52 kg/m3. The CoolProp revision bundled with this CoolSolve build (8.1.0-dev) now ships a conductivity model for R1233zd(E) from the same paper, so CONDUCTIVITY('R1233zd(E)',...) evaluates and agrees with conductivity_R1233zd_published to 0.1 % in the liquid; the inventory note that CoolProp has none was verified with 7.2.0/8.0.0 (PropsSI('L',...) raises) but no longer holds for the bundled backend.

related_external: Perkins & Huber (2017), Table 1 coefficients and Table 2 data, reproduced in the CoolProp transport block of dev/fluids/R1233zd(E).json
